scope: 3 matched prematch fixtures; 48 unique numeric score selections, 64 bookmaker-score comparisons. Matched both teams and exact kickoff. Site figures captured freshly, no bets placed.

definitions.isports: Bookmaker BACK correct-score net odds. Decimal = net + 1. Not an exchange lay quote.
definitions.betfair: Exchange decimal back and lay quotes as supplied by betfair-odds.com.
definitions.hypothetical: 100 / isportsNetBackOdds is profit per 100 liability ONLY IF one hypothetically offered lay at that same decimal back price. It is not an executable lay price supplied by iSports.
definitions.site: Displayed percentage; stake/settlement basis remains unverified.

limitations: Snapshots not simultaneous. iSports capture 09:00:15 UTC; website 09:01:52–09:03:27 UTC; Betfair reference 09:03 UTC. Individual changeTime is last price change, not necessarily feed delay. A quoted price is not a guaranteed executable amount. No claim of a universal site pricing formula.
